bg_track_1.prompt: A background painting for a 2D animated comedy, with NO characters and no people close by: the only people are far-off spectators painted as small soft blurred shapes of colour with no faces. Vertical 9:16. Seen from a standing person's eye height in the front row of a grandstand beside a motor racing circuit on a windy, bright overcast day, the way a phone held at arm's length sees what is behind its owner (never from above). The top fifth of the picture is a bright, pale, overcast sky of soft white and light grey clouds. Below the sky, on the far side of the track, a long low far grandstand with a plain flat grey roof, its seats full of spectators painted only as a soft speckled band of muted colours, and a few soft trees. In front of it, running straight across the whole width of the picture at about one third of the way down from the top, the race track: a wide, flat, empty band of smooth dark-grey tarmac with a thin white line along each edge and low red-and-white striped kerbs along its near edge, empty, no cars on it; it is seen most clearly in the UPPER LEFT third of the picture. On our side of the track a strip of green grass and a low plain grey concrete wall. Close behind the viewer, across the whole picture from the bottom up to well above the track, stands the catch fence: a few tall thin grey steel posts far apart and a fine, faint diamond wire mesh between them, painted lightly so that the track and everything behind it is clearly seen through it. The lower half of the picture is quiet and plain: the fence in front of the grass verge and the top of the plain grey concrete wall at the front of our grandstand. Soft even daylight from the overcast sky, no strong shadows. The horizon is tilted two or three degrees. Painted softly by hand in the manner of the background of the reference picture: gentle muted colours, soft edges, far less detail and contrast than a character would have, no black outlines. Take only the painting manner from the reference picture and nothing of what it shows. No cars, no text, no signs, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no flags, no banners, no advertising boards, no screens, no scoreboard, nothing written on the walls or the roof.
